name: RC-B10-0528/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop persecuting the Baha'i religious minority. It asks Iran to release people jailed for their faith, stop seizing property and cemeteries, and let Baha'is study and work. It also asks the European Union to raise these abuses with Iran and to sanction judges and officials responsible. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands that Iran release named Baha'i prisoners and end discrimination.
- It asks the European Union to sanction Iranian judges, prosecutors and intelligence officers.
- It urges the European Union to treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist group.
